register_shell_hooks_from_config: register shell hooks from a config dict, optionally auto-accepting without TTY prompts
list_configured_hooks: list configured shell hook specs from a config dict without registering them
run_shell_hook_once: run a single shell-hook invocation with a synthetic payload for testing
check_shell_hook_allowlist: check if a shell hook event and command pair is already allowlisted
revoke_shell_hook_approvals: revoke all allowlist entries matching a given shell hook command
